MTOR.scope: Completed in v3: four-page main, all main figure panels, complete TableS1 and FigureS1A/B. No duplicate read.
MTOR.qualification: PKD1 alternative renal etiology, uncertain MTOR-polyposis attribution and ID/LGA specificity remain; see v3.

KCNJ2.finding: SupplementS1 pedigree/trace supports the affected heterozygous proband and genetically unaffected parents; QT200ms remains supported. Electrophysiology and computer simulations are distinct from observed patient arrhythmias.
KCNJ2.qualification: Do not treat simulated reentry or calcium-current modifications as patient outcomes. S8 panel text/legend ordering is imperfect; no benchmark label depends on that ordering.

CTCF.finding: MainFigure2 does not depict selected individual32. MainRNAseqFigure3 and supplemental structural/localization experiments do not establish variant-specific function for Arg390His. SelectedTableS1 AG1:AG56 remains the direct case source.
CTCF.qualification: Source likely-pathogenic classification and additional de novo CAPRIN1 allele retained; not uniquely established causal truth.

LZTR1.finding: Figure2I/J/K depicts Family4II1 at3,7,14years. Full methods appendix confirms homozygous Glu563Gln in II1 and postmortem affectedII2, both parents heterozygous. MainFigure3 and supplemental splicing/NMD traces concern other families.
LZTR1.qualification: Appendix explicitly says later length around third centile; packet excluded-short-stature label remains unreliable. Positive labels and frozen arms retained; no functional splicing evidence transferred to Glu563Gln.

INTS11.finding: Family10 narrative confirms homozygous c.68G>T/p.Arg23Leu in all three affected subjects, heterozygous parents; subject13=F10S1. Selected phenotype narrative supports absent speech, profound ID, hypotonia, microcephaly, facial features and inability to walk.
INTS11.qualification: New source-internal conflict: TableS1 marks delayed gross motor development No for subject13, while the narrative says unable to walk at12. Retain HP:0001270 with explicit conflicting-table qualifier. Corresponding flyArg17Leu failure-to-rescue remains ortholog evidence; no human-mutant rescue claim.
INTS11.correction_to_old_scope: MainFigure1 is the variant/clinical overview; the earlier shorthand pedigree/variant pixels should not imply a pedigree image was inspected there.

BCKDHB.finding: TableI identifies D.M. homozygous V69G-beta, no residual E1beta protein, classicMSUD. Figure4C is structural modeling from wild-type coordinates; the V69G construct did not express in the soluble bacterial fraction.
BCKDHB.qualification: TMAO activity rescue in Figure2 concerns H156Y, not selected V69G. Six phenotype labels remain a generic classicMSUD projection rather than individually documented findings. No separate supplement was identified in the inspected main text.

DOCK8.scope: All mainfigures now visually read; 28-page appendix complete in v3, not duplicated.
DOCK8.finding: Figure2 depicts individual-coded clinical laboratories; Figure4 family1 experiments must not be assigned to patient8-2. Selected allele/transcript reconciliation and appendixTableS2 review remain as in v3.
DOCK8.qualification: Individual8-2 Sanger trace not supplied; sibling8-1 trace/shared allele assignment and source clinical/recurrence/cellulitis qualifications remain.

COG8.finding: Figure4 directly shows maternal IVS3+1G>A and paternal1687–1688delTT in the patient, supporting trans inheritance. Figures1–3 show glycosylation/transport/COG-subunit defects. Figure5 shows complementation with wild-typeCOG8.
COG8.qualification: Legacy splice coordinate normalization caveat retained. Full publisher HTML accessible through authorized UOC and article figures held; a genuine main PDF was not downloaded.

SLC35C1.finding: S1 explicitly assays proband2IgG before/after fucosidase. S2B/H are proband2; panelsF/L concern proband1. CBCvalues for both probands read.
SLC35C1.qualification: Severe ID for youngerproband2 remains unsupported. Movie descriptions read but three movie files not viewed; no movie-based evidence asserted.
